title: GEMglStencilMask
description: control the front and back writing of individual bits in the stencil planes

messages.description: bit mask of the stencil bits that may be written

arguments.description: bit mask of the stencil bits that may be written

body: [GEMglStencilMask] calls glStencilMask() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glStencilMask in the OpenGL reference.
